title: The Impact of Training Data Composition on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards: Theoretical Analysis and Empirical Investigation

contributions.purpose: 刻画训练数据构成与 RLVR 性能的关系并给收敛保证
contributions.mechanism: 分析 verified/unverified 样本比例对收敛与最终性能界的影响
contributions.evaluation: 定理4 存在最优覆盖率 ρ*≈0.6(偏差-方差权衡);样本复杂度界 O(|S||A|k)
contributions.source_quote: A comprehensive theoretical framework characterizing the relationship between training data composition and RLVR performance with explicit convergence guarantees

contributions.purpose: 提出可验证奖励一致性指标及其抗噪扩展
contributions.mechanism: 定义 VRCI 及噪声约束下的 VRCI-R,并作理论论证
contributions.evaluation: 合成实验中 VRCI 与最终策略性能相关 0.85;VRCI-R 在 20% 约束噪声下仍保持相关性
contributions.source_quote: Theoretical justification for the Verifiable Reward Consistency Index (VRCI) and its robust extension (VRCI-R) under noisy constraints

contributions.purpose: 给出 RLVR 可扩展性与验证学习的根本限
contributions.mechanism: 计算复杂度分析+层级验证约束+信息论下界
contributions.evaluation: 定性:验证瓶颈复杂度界、层级验证样本效率、verifiable learning 信息论下界(理论)
contributions.source_quote: Information-theoretic bounds on the fundamental limits of verifiable reward learning

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends this foundation by providing mathematical guarantees for verification-based approaches.
Our work extends these concepts to reinforcement learning with novel theoretical results on verification-guided training.

notes: 理论为主+初步合成实证。实证仅 10x10 GridWorld synthetic 环境,结果以叙述给出(ρ*≈0.6、样本复杂度在理论 2 倍内、VRCI 相关 0.85、VRCI-R 抗 20% 噪声),无结果表格、无对照基线、无随机种子。数据红旗:checklist reproducibility 答 Yes 但 open access 答 NA(称'primarily focused on theory'),experimental settings 又答 Yes——实证范围与披露不一致;simulated/synthetic baseline 支撑核心定理,属'循环自证'倾向(合成环境按理论假设构造再回证理论)。作者承认 Lipschitz 连续与有限状态空间假设可能不成立(trade-off)。贡献以其 8 条列表归并为 3 组。
